Resume tips for Capgemini

  • For SAP/ERP roles, list the exact modules (SAP MM, SAP ABAP, SAP FICO) rather than "SAP experience".
  • Highlight any global delivery or client-facing project exposure prominently — Capgemini staffs heavily on international accounts.
  • Mention agile delivery experience (Scrum, Kanban) since most Capgemini teams run agile pods.
  • Keep certifications (cloud, SAP, PMP) in a dedicated, scannable section near the top.

Frequently asked questions

Does Capgemini use an ATS to screen resumes?

Capgemini’s recruiters commonly search their ATS by exact tool/module keywords, so precise, current terminology outperforms broad category terms.

What are Capgemini's typical interview rounds?

Most candidates go through: Online Assessment → Technical Interview → Client/Project Fitment Round → HR Round.
